full_judgment: 2. Brief facts are that the respondent No. 2, as informant, lodged FIR before Nazirpur Police Station stating that on 9-5-1998 at 6-00 AM the accused petitioner and others forming unlawful assembly with deadly weapons entered the schedule land and cut and took away ripe paddy valued at Taka 1,25,000 and on getting the information when the informant came to the place of occurrence the accused’s attacked him with intent to kill him; on the basis of above FIR, Nazirpur PS Case No. 12 dated 9-5-1998 was registered under sections 147/347/379 of the Penal Code and after investigation the police on 8-9-1999 submitted charge sheet under sections 143/447/379 of the Penal Code against 33 persons including the accused petitioner. Then, on 4-11-1999 the learned Magistrate framed charges against the accused persons but on the basis of the application filed by the accused petitioner under section 241A of the Code of Criminal Procedure discharged him. Against the said order of discharge the informant filed Criminal Revision No. 130 of 1999 before the learned Sessions Judge, Perojpur and the learned Additional Sessions Judge, who heard the above revision, by judgment and order dated 31-7-2002 rejected the same. The informant then preferred Criminal Revision No. 549 of 2003 before the High Court Division challenging the above order dated 31-7-2002 and the High Court Division, after hearing, made the Rule absolute.
